lines.text: The people are told to ask the LORD for rain, but they wander like sheep for lack of a shepherd.
The LORD will punish the leaders, make His flock His royal steed, and bring the cornerstone from Benjamin.

wrong_details.true: the cornerstone will come from Judah

lines.text: The LORD will strengthen Judah, save the house of Joseph, and restore them because He has compassion on them.
The LORD will whistle for His people because He redeemed them, and bring them back from Babylon and Assyria.
Assyria's pride will be brought down, and the LORD will strengthen His people so they walk in His name.
